title: Tenant
description: Internal tenant record. Joined to Clerk org and Stripe customer.

config.description: Safe tenant configuration mirror of /tenant/config. The calendarProfile is stored inline so the cache-key path tenants.config.calendarProfile.version (per docs/contracts/cache-key.md) is satisfied without a join.

ecclesiasticalJurisdiction.description: Tenant ecclesiastical jurisdiction. Independent of calendarProfile (e.g., a GOARCH-jurisdiction tenant may run a revised-Julian fixed-feast calendar with a Julian Paschalion). Surfaces in citation context; drives the institutional_policy answer mode in Phase 2+. Phase 1: optional; recorded but not retrieval-influential. Use 'other' with ecclesiasticalJurisdictionOther for any value not in this enum.

ecclesiasticalJurisdictionOther.description: Free-text jurisdiction descriptor when ecclesiasticalJurisdiction == 'other'. Reviewer-facing; not parsed by retrieval or composition. Must be null when ecclesiasticalJurisdiction is any value other than 'other'.

corpusVersion.description: System-managed pointer to the active corpus version for this tenant. Set by the ingestion service on cutover; surfaces in cache-key recipe and on GET /tenant/config (read-only). Not editable via PATCH /tenant/config.
